# What Pokemon Type Are You Skill

This skill runs a short, fun quiz in chat that matches your answers to one Pokemon type style. It asks ten original preference questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, then names one type and one style, with a simple activity to try. It is just for fun, not a personality test, and not buying advice for any game.

Unofficial, not affiliated with Nintendo or The Pokemon Company. No official image, text, music or logo is copied.
